select.note: OpenSkiMap has one area for all of Dolomiti Superski. The four valleys around the Sella: Val Gardena, Alta Badia, Arabba and Canazei (Belvedere, Col Rodella, Pordoi). Out: Seiser Alm (and the Ortisei - Furdenan runs, which OpenSkiMap puts under it), Marmolada, Buffaure - Ciampac and Lagazuoi. A box at the south-west corner (Furdenan, Sanon, Mont Seuc) belongs to Seiser Alm, and the southern edge stops above Pera and Pozza (Vajolet).
exclude_boxes: Furdenan, Sanon and Mont Seuc above Ortisei: OpenSkiMap puts them under Seiser Alm
